newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-ITALY CALL UP MARTELLI FOR DAVIS CLASH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ITALY CALL UP MARTELLI FOR DAVIS CLASH.

text.p: Italy made one change to their Davies Cup team on Monday ahead of next month's quarter-final tie against Spain, calling up cup debutant Marzio Martelli in place of Stefano Pescosolido.
Italian number one Renzo Furlan, veteran Omar Camporese and Diego Nargiso were all retained from the team that beat Mexico in the first round last month.
Martelli, 25, is ranked 142nd in the world in the singles listings and 380th in the doubles.
Italy, which lost to France in the semifinals of the Davis Cup last year, are due to play Spain on home territory, in Pesaro.
